rationale_one_line: headroom is a developer-infrastructure tool whose entire pitch is a set of numbers (60-95% fewer tokens, accuracy held), so RECEIPT lets the numbers do the proving; all eight generic presets are blocked inside the last 14 history entries, so the pick moves to a brand pack, and Supabase's quietly-technical dark developer surface with a single emerald-green event maps onto headroom's efficiency-and-savings story (green reads as the win) while glowing for the halation gate.
writing_tone_notes: Engineer-to-engineer, cost-aware, build-in-public peer. Plain declarative, no superlatives; the 92%-down-yet-accuracy-held contrast carries the praise. Emerald is the only chromatic event, reserved for the hero numeral accents and the close, Supabase-style. Reserve the star-velocity metric for the X caption only; scenes stay qualitative or use the benchmark numbers, never the star count.
do_rules: Lead the video on the compression magnitude (a hero numeral), not the star count.
Make a big_number the visual hero and pair two numbers in tension: the cut, then the accuracy that survives it.
Reserve the 11k-stars and 3,500-a-day velocity for the X caption; scenes use the benchmark numbers instead.
Use contractions where natural. Keep emerald scarce, on the numerals and close only.
dont_rules: No version numbers anywhere in the X caption (no v0.22.4).
No reuse of scene phrases (trim the reads, keep the signal, less in the window, more left to spend, fewer tokens to the model) in the caption or Why-this-one.
No superlatives and no fastest-ever claims; lead with the metric instead.
No framework repeat of CLASSIC (most recent on 2026-06-03); RECEIPT chosen.
